pricing_knowledge.note: High-ticket, seasonal weddings + corporate. Fast acknowledgement + package recommendation wins bookings. An AI agent responding instantly and checking availability protects their finite date inventory.

business_profile.competitive_position: Look N Feel competes with Ananta, Metro Weddings, and other planners. Their edge is 800+ events and insider venue access. But phone-only intake loses bookings to planners with faster response. An AI enquiry + availability agent would convert more wedding enquiries.
business_profile.opportunity_size: High-ticket weddings with finite dates mean every enquiry lost to a slower response is unrecoverable. An AI agent that acknowledges instantly and checks availability recovers bookings and fills the wedding calendar faster.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI enquiry agent acknowledging every wedding/corporate request instantly.
2. Package recommendation + availability checking.
3. Seasonal spike handling.
4. Post-event follow-up + referral nurturing.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A couple messages Look N Feel at 10pm about a Walima in February. The AI replies in seconds: 'February dates are filling — let me check availability. For a Walima, our [package] fits. Guest count and venue preference?' The couple answers; a tailored quote and availability follow.
